mods.description: A Simple Voice Chat addon that adds useful roleplay based features

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
- Implemented voice cycles (carousel mode) to cycle through voice states
  - This disables whisper keybind
  - Ranges:
    - Whisper
    - Normal
    - Shouting
    - Extended (when effect is applied or holding item)
- In game text chat now displays only for players in voice range
  - Respects spectator interaction config from main mod
- Dead players are silenced in voice chat but can still use the text chat (normal range)
- Implemented negated speech and extended speech effects
- Implemented Voice Extender item (same as extended speech effect)
- Updated GUI
  - Replaced in game icons with custom animated ones
  - Replaced menu backgrounds to fit the style
- Added cycle mode button selector in mod settings menu
- Blocked "Adjust Volume" and "Group" menus
- Config file now generates directly in the `config/` directory with mod ID as filename
- Updated default config values

## New Contributors
* @NormanNoonePhilips made their first contribution in https://github.com/Brodino96/RoleplaySimpleVoicechat/pull/2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Brodino96/RoleplaySimpleVoicechat/compare/1.19.2-1.1.1...1.19.2-2.0.0
